Geographies Served Programs Titli Skill Development Program District Jaipur State Rajasthan District Jaipur States Rajasthan The Titli Vocational and Skill Development Program is designed to empower girls and women from marginalized communities by providing them with vocational training, employable skills, and access to employment opportunities. The program aims to enhance their economic empowerment, promote gender equality, and contribute to sustainable development. By focusing on education, employment, empowerment, and the environment, Titli aims to build a comprehensive and holistic approach to women’s empowerment and community development. Project Objectives: 1. Education and Capacity Building 2.Employment and Entrepreneurship 3.Empowerment and Leadership 4.Environment and Sustainable Practices Titlam – Women Entrepreneurship Program District Jaipur Indore State Rajasthan District Jaipur Indore States Rajasthan Titlam Women Entrepreneurship Program is designed to support and empower women with existing skills or those seeking to develop new skills to start and grow their own businesses. The program aims to provide women with the necessary knowledge, resources, mentorship, and networking opportunities to become successful entrepreneurs. By fostering entrepreneurship and providing a supportive ecosystem, Titlam aims to promote women’s economic empowerment and foster their contribution to the business world. Project Objectives: 1.Skill Development 2.Business Incubation 3.Access to Resources 4.Peer Support and Networking 5.Sustainability and Growth Spotless Dame: Empowering Menstruation Awareness and Capacity Building Program" District Kota Dhar Jaipur Udaipur Alwar Bikaner Jodhpur Bundi Bhilwara Ajmer State Madhya Pradesh Rajasthan District Kota Dhar Jaipur Udaipur Alwar Bikaner Jodhpur Bundi Bhilwara Ajmer States Madhya Pradesh Rajasthan Spotless Dame is an innovative initiative aimed at creating awareness around menstruation hygiene management, educating girls and women on safe practices during periods, and breaking the silence and stigma associated with menstruation. The project will also focus on providing an environmentally friendly and cost-effective solution by introducing MeraPad, a reusable cloth pad made of Bamboo Charcoal. Through education, employment, empowerment, and environmental sustainability, Spotless Dame aims to transform the lives of women and girls, promoting their health, well-being, and dignity. Project Objectives: 1.Menstruation Awareness and Education 2,Employment and Capacity Building 3,Empowerment and Women’s Health 4.Environmental Sustainability 5.Monitoring and Evaluation Food Steps – Mother & Child Care Program District Jaipur Bundi State Rajasthan District Jaipur Bundi States Rajasthan Food Steps is a comprehensive project designed to provide essential support and resources to expecting and lactating mothers, ensuring their optimal nutrition and well-being. The project aims to address the specific dietary and nutritional needs of mothers during pregnancy and lactation, promoting healthy pregnancies, breastfeeding practices, and the overall health of mothers and their babies. By offering knowledge, access to nutritious food, and guidance, Foodsteps seeks to improve maternal and child health outcomes and contribute to the long-term well-being of families. Project Objectives: 1.Nutrition Education 2.Food Assistance 3.Health Monitoring and Support 4.Breastfeeding Support 5.Skill Development and Empowerment 6.Community Engagement and Awareness 7.Monitoring and Evaluation Swast Kiran – COVID Relief & Disaster Management District Kota Jaipur Udaipur Alwar Bikaner Bundi Bhilwara Ajmer State Rajasthan District Kota Jaipur Udaipur Alwar Bikaner Bundi Bhilwara Ajmer States Rajasthan Swast Kiran is a comprehensive project initiated by PraveenLata Sansthan aimed at providing COVID relief and disaster management support in communities affected by the ongoing pandemic and other emergencies. The project focuses on addressing the immediate needs of affected individuals and communities, as well as building resilience to future disasters. Through a range of interventions, Swasth Kiran aims to provide relief, support, and rehabilitation to those impacted by COVID-19 and other disasters. Project Objectives 1.Emergency Relief Distribution 2.Healthcare Support 3.Livelihood and Economic Recovery 4.Education and Psychosocial Support 5.Capacity Building and Disaster Preparedness 6.Advocacy and Policy Engagement Laadli – Remedial Education & Outreach Scholarship Program District Jaipur State Rajasthan District Jaipur States Rajasthan Laadli is a comprehensive program aimed at promoting gender equality and quality education for girls from underprivileged communities in India. The project focuses on providing remedial education support, bridging the education gap, and empowering girls to enroll back in school. Laadli Laadli also aims to create awareness among the community, strengthen the support system of government schools, upgrade infrastructure, provide vocational training, and offer outreach scholarships to support students in continuing their higher studies. Project Objectives: 1.Creating awareness on gender equality & promoting girls’ education 2.Remedial education support 3.Support system for government schools 4.Upgradation of infrastructure support in government schools 5.Vocational training for students in government schools 6.Focus on life skills & soft skills 7.Outreach scholarship support SHIKSHA SETU – Empowering Children through Educational Guidance and Women Mentorship District Jaipur State Rajasthan District Jaipur States Rajasthan The SHIKSHA SETU project aims to provide educational guidance and support to children living in villages and slums who cannot afford regular school attendance and lack access to educational resources. It seeks to bridge the educational gap by engaging educated women from the community as mentors and role models for these children. Through mentorship, the project aims to enhance the children’s educational opportunities, inspire them to pursue learning, and empower them for a brighter future Project Objectives 1.Increase access
